name: s5-corpus-24-task-stratified
title: Build the §5/§6 24-task stratified ablation corpus (20 new tasks across 7 categories) + corpus self-validation smoke, frozen for the powered run
description: Apply 20 pre-validated stratified tasks (bug-fix/refactor/test-repair/doc-update/dep-upgrade/contract-validation/CLI-feature) under experiments/recovery-runner/tasks/ to reach the pre-reg §2 24-task / 8-category corpus, plus a corpus-selfcheck.mjs that machine-checks the passes-acceptance-but-fails-ground-truth invariant for all 24 tasks via the canonical inject() path and asserts the stratification, wired into npm test:experiments. Freezes the corpus before the multi-day powered run. All 20 new tasks were independently re-validated end-to-end before this story.
